name: Grand Rebellion!

gist.Champion, the Stormbringer: Spends his action to discard up to five cards and redraw; you must then do the same.
gist.Cute Nerd Magenta: Discards a card to put any card from the deck into the discard pile.
gist.Johanna, Crusader of Light: Keeps the other two immune to statuses and shares their damage.
gist.Kappa Sword Slash: A very heavy single hit, cheaper for every different Rebelliokai in his discard pile; costs a Kappa from that pile.
gist.Kirin Firebreath: A small hit repeated once for every different Rebelliokai in his discard pile; costs a Kirin from it.
gist.Tengu Windstorm: Puts any non-hero card on the board on top or bottom of its owner's deck; costs a Tengu from the pile.
gist.Tanuki Escape: Swaps hand cards for searched ones; costs a Tanuki from the pile.
gist.Rebelliokai Terror Tengu: On arrival summons up to three different Rebelliokai from the discard pile, then ends his turn.
gist.Rebelliokai Oblivious Oni: Sturdy; only playable with five different Rebelliokai in the discard pile; then hits widely every turn.
gist.Rebelliokai Timid Tanuki: Draws a card per different Rebelliokai in the discard pile.
gist.Rebelliokai Camouflaged Kappa: Sacrifices itself to search a card and discard it.
gist.Rebelliokai Courtly Kirin: Jumps in when you use a hero's effect, by discarding another Rebelliokai.
gist.Rebelliokai Kind Kitsune: Discarded by a Rebelliokai effect, returns a non-creature card from the discard pile.
gist.Rebelliokai Backup Bakus: Returns from the discard pile to hand when another Rebelliokai is discarded.

plan: A rebellion run from the discard pile. Tariq throws his Rebelliokai away on purpose (Champion, Magenta, Inventing), and every different one lying there makes his four signature cards stronger: a sword slash that removes a hero, a fire breath that hits once per name, a windstorm that puts your attachment back into your deck, a card swap. Each use deletes one creature from the pile, and Terror Tengu brings three back at once. Killing his creatures only fills the pile; his heroes and his discard outlets are the way in.

looks.early: Creatures going straight from hand to discard pile.
looks.mid: Five names in the pile; a Firebreath in five hits, your Storm blown back into your deck.
looks.late: An Oni on the board and a Sword Slash every turn.

opening.tell: He is discarding his own creatures and has almost no board.
opening.why: The pile is harmless for the first turns and his heroes are open; killing what little he summons only adds names to it.

midgame.tell: Five different Rebelliokai lie in his discard pile and Champion discards five more each turn.
midgame.why: Freeze Champion, the outlet; his forced redraw also throws away your hand, so play it out first. Sweeping feeds the pile.

crisis.tell: Kappa Sword Slash now costs him nothing and Tengu Windstorm is aimed at your Storm.
crisis.why: One slash a turn on one hero: Cloud in a Bottle and Homerun!; keep a second Storm in hand rather than on the table.

endgame.tell: Each of his spells has deleted a creature and the pile is thin.
endgame.why: His finishers eat their own fuel.

opening.board: Tariq discards three Rebelliokai with Magenta and Inventing and summons nothing.
Champion discards five and redraws; you must do the same.

options.text: Chain Lightning with the new hand

opening.board: A Kappa sacrifices itself to put a card in the pile.

midgame.board: Five names in the pile; Kirin Firebreath hits five times.

options.text: Freeze Champion; play your hand out

midgame.board: Terror Tengu brings three back at once and his turn ends.

options.text: Kill a discarder, not the creatures

crisis.board: Kappa Sword Slash, free, aimed at your caster.
Tengu Windstorm puts your Storm on the bottom of your deck.

options.text: Keep the next one in hand; tick with spells

crisis.board: Courtly Kirin jumps in when Tarleinn heals.

endgame.board: Two names left in the pile.
